notes: Trip line: corners are rounded, points are recorded closer together, and the line width now follows the map zoom.
New option 'Snap trip to roads (online)' lines the trip up with the roads using the public OSRM service. Off by default; it sends your trip points over the internet when switched on.
Map under the radar is steadier.

New Units tab: bind companions and repeaters to this CAIRN by radio ID. Each gets a CRU ID (CRU-01, CRU-02...) and a name (needs CAIRN firmware 1.4.1 on the radio).
Call signs/names on the map, radar and lists, movement trails, and a banner when a unit has not been heard for a while.
Trip line for a moving CAIRN, optional snap to roads (online), map under the radar.
New 'Share trace' and 'Open a trace file' buttons: send a recorded trip from your phone to another device and replay it there. Tested with files in a browser only.
First release of the LODESTAR PULSAR dashboard. Works over USB; Bluetooth and WiFi need firmware support that Pulsar does not have yet.
